DK27.0 is a medical diagnosis code representing acute gastroduodenal ulcer with hemorrhage (*akut gastroduodenalt ulcus med blødning*). Within the Danish healthcare system, this specific code plays a critical role in monitoring patient safety and treatment outcomes for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]]. 

According to the annual reports from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (*Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark*), managed by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), DK27.0 is utilized as part of a comprehensive clinical quality indicator tracking the incidence of severe bleeding events [^src1]. Because patients with atrial fibrillation are frequently prescribed anticoagulants, monitoring severe bleeding is a vital metric for evaluating treatment safety. To capture these events accurately, the database employs a broad spectrum of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes. DK27.0 is grouped alongside other gastrointestinal bleeding codes (such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] and [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]]), intracranial bleeding codes (like [[di60|DI60]]), and urinary or respiratory bleeding codes to form the numerator for the severe bleeding incidence indicator [^src1]. 

The methodology and exact code definitions for this indicator, including DK27.0, are formally documented in the technical reference sections of the RKKP's annual reports [^src1] [^src2]. This rigorous documentation ensures standardized data collection, enabling reliable clinical quality measurement and regional comparison across the Danish healthcare system.
